drafts.title: Archived Report: Cerebras and Mistral Claim 1,100 Tokens/s Inference Speed on Mistral Large 2 Using Wafer Scale Engine 3
drafts.body: An archived third-party report from early 2025 details a collaboration between Cerebras and Mistral integrating Cerebras Inference into Mistral's Le Chat platform, achieving a reported AI inference speed breakthrough. Specifically, the system is claimed to generate text at 1,100 tokens per second using the 123 billion parameter Mistral Large 2 model. This speed reportedly represents a roughly 10x improvement over contemporaneous AI assistants like ChatGPT 4o (115 tokens/s) and Claude Sonnet 3.5 (71 tokens/s). The performance gain is attributed to Cerebras's Wafer Scale Engine 3 technology, which employs an SRAM-based inference architecture, combined with speculative decoding methods developed jointly with Mistral researchers. The new feature, called "Flash Answers," currently focuses on text-based queries and is visually indicated by a lightning bolt icon in the chat interface. It is important to note that these claims come from a third-party archive citing vendor statements, without independent verification, and the speed comparisons may not reflect identical test conditions or current rankings. Nonetheless, this report highlights the potential of hardware-software co-design in pushing the boundaries of LLM inference speed.

drafts.title: Archived Report: Cerebras + Mistral Claim 1,100 Tokens/s on Mistral Large 2 Via Wafer Scale Engine 3 Integration
drafts.body: An archived third-party report from early 2025 details a collaboration between Cerebras and Mistral integrating Cerebras Inference technology into Mistral's Le Chat platform. This integration reportedly achieves an AI inference speed of 1,100 tokens per second using the 123 billion parameter Mistral Large 2 model. The breakthrough is attributed to Cerebras's Wafer Scale Engine 3, which employs an SRAM-based inference architecture, combined with speculative decoding techniques developed alongside Mistral researchers. While the report highlights this as a significant hardware-software co-design milestone, it is important to note these are vendor claims from a third-party archive without independent verification. The speed is said to be substantially faster than some contemporary AI assistants, but direct comparisons lack established equivalence in testing conditions. The feature enabling this performance, branded as "Flash Answers," currently focuses on text-based queries. This claim illustrates potential directions in accelerating large language model inference but should be considered within the context of its source and stated limitations.

drafts.title: 归档报告：Cerebras与Mistral声称通过Wafer Scale Engine 3在Mistral Large 2上实现1100令牌/秒推理速度突破
drafts.body: 一份2025年初的归档第三方报告详细介绍了Cerebras与Mistral的合作，将Cerebras推理集成到Mistral的Le Chat平台，实现了据称的AI推理速度突破。具体而言，该系统声称使用1230亿参数的Mistral Large 2模型，文本生成速度达到1100令牌每秒。据称该速度相比同期AI助手如ChatGPT 4o（115令牌/秒）和Claude Sonnet 3.5（71令牌/秒）提升约10倍。性能提升归因于Cerebras的Wafer Scale Engine 3技术，该技术采用基于SRAM的推理架构，结合与Mistral研究人员共同开发的推测解码方法。新功能名为“闪电答案”，目前专注于基于文本的查询，并在聊天界面以闪电图标视觉标识。需注意，这些声明来自第三方归档引用的厂商陈述，未经独立验证，且速度比较可能不反映相同测试条件或当前排名。尽管如此，该报告凸显了硬件与软件协同设计在推动大型语言模型推理速度极限方面的潜力。

drafts.body: 一份2025年初的归档第三方报告详细介绍了Cerebras与Mistral的合作，将Cerebras推理技术集成到Mistral的Le Chat平台。据称该集成实现了使用1230亿参数Mistral Large 2模型的1100令牌每秒AI推理速度突破。该突破归功于Cerebras的Wafer Scale Engine 3技术，采用基于SRAM的推理架构，结合与Mistral研究人员共同开发的推测解码技术。虽然报告强调这是硬件与软件协同设计的重要里程碑，但需注意这些为第三方归档中的厂商声明，未经独立验证。速度据称远超部分同期AI助手，但直接比较缺乏测试条件等效性。支持该性能的功能名为“闪电答案”，目前专注于基于文本的查询。该声明展示了加速大型语言模型推理的潜在方向，但应结合其来源及声明限制加以考虑。
